decisions.evidence: Overall, the molecule carries several features that can limit oral bioavailability, especially the large surface area, tertiary hydroxyl, tertiary amine, piperazine, lactam count, and only moderate QED, but the ring-rich and partially saturated structure gives enough counterbalance that the net profile is still more consistent with oral bioavailability at or above it.
The balance of the six comparisons therefore supports option (A): has oral bioavailability < 20%.
